versions.changelog:
- Updated documentation to improve clarity and navigation, especially for new users.
- Restructured the skill index to use clear headings and simplified descriptions for each section.
- Added dedicated sections summarizing web browsing, file structure, and maintainer instructions.
- No file or code changes; documentation only.

Initial release of speed-skills: a comprehensive agentic skill hub for the Speed-CLI.

- Provides indexed documentation for install, protocol, commands, scripting, orchestration, security, and more
- Each skill category links directly to corresponding GitHub markdown files
- Includes guidance for skill usage, CLI flag exploration, and script catalog integrations
- Structured for GitHub Pages deployment as a documentation root
- Emphasizes mental models, tables, and actionable sections for CLI users

- Added new SKILL.md describing the "agentic-building-blocks" for composing trading strategies with speed-skills.
- Provides a CLI-to-Lego metaphor to explain how core commands (quote, swap, balance, etc.) can be stacked into custom loops and strategies.
- Details base vs target token conventions, strategy family types, and best practices for avoiding bot strategy overlap.
- Includes guidance on handling decimals, validation steps before risk deployment, and links to related skill documentation.
- Emphasizes explicit parameter usage and careful strategy composition to avoid execution hazards.
